'''Nash Squared''' (formerly known as '''Harvey Nash Group''') is a global digital services consultancy providing outsourced digital transformation development services as well as technology talent acquisition services. They were formerly listed on the [[London Stock Exchange]]<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/prices-and-markets/stocks/summary/company-summary.html?fourWayKey=GB0006573546GBGBXSET3 |title=HARVEY NASH GROUP PLC ORD 5P Share Price - Shares - London Stock Exchange |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |access-date=11 September 2013}}</ref> but became a privately listed company in 2018 following a near total buyout by DBAY Advisors.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kemp |first1=Kenny |title=Harvey Nash steps off publicly-listed AIM |url=https://www.insider.co.uk/news/harvey-nash-recruitment-offices-delisted-13785091 |access-date=5 September 2019 |publisher=Insider Publications Ltd |date=28 December 2018}}</ref>

The company operates from over 40 offices in 16 countries, covering the United States, [[Europe]] and [[Asia]].  The organisation is made up of [http://www.harveynash.com Harvey Nash], [http://www.crimson.co.uk Crimson], [http://www.wearespinks.com Spinks] and [http://www.talent-it.be Talent-IT].

Harvey Nash, the firm's flagship talent acquisition subbrand, primarily recruits and staffs developers at client companies. Harvey Nash also provides executive search and talent management services. Harvey Nash is a major sponsor of CivTech Accelerator, a 15-week intense curriculum combining rapid product development and business courses. The winners will be accepted into the [[Scottish Government]]'s CivTech Accelerator initiative, which seeks to resolve a range of problems faced by public sector entities, including national charities and local councils.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Walker|first=Peter A.|date=2021-10-12|title=CivTech announces Accelerator programme participants|url=https://www.insider.co.uk/news/civtech-announces-accelerator-programme-participants-25193040|access-date=2021-10-27|website=businessInsider|language=en}}</ref>
